title: Spotlight counts presses on the owner's own link list, not only on Link cards

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: Click counts (LIVE-856) cover only Link cards (book, contact, product, Journey, event, membership). The Links block, the free list of URLs that is what a link-in-bio is, renders plain anchors with no beacon (components/entity-blocks/content-block-view.tsx, and the themed layouts that draw facts.links), and the click endpoint's TARGET pattern refuses any other target. Production 2026-11-17: 6 published Space Spotlights, 1 Space click ever (2026-11-03); Daniel's own Spotlight carries 15 links in a Links block and its console shows no counts for any of them. Fix needs a stable per-link target (a short hash of the URL survives reordering), a counted anchor in the Links renderer and the themed link layouts when inSpotlightRender(), the console mapping those targets back to the link labels, and the hosted /spotlight-click path on a website host.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
